title: Lost in the Fields of Buttercups
attribution: Excerpted verbatim from The Wonderful Wizard of Oz by L. Frank Baum (1900).
body: Dorothy went to the Witch’s cupboard to fill her basket with food for the journey, and there she saw the Golden Cap. She tried it on her own head and found that it fitted her exactly. She did not know anything about the charm of the Golden Cap, but she saw that it was pretty, so she made up her mind to wear it and carry her sunbonnet in the basket.
Then, being prepared for the journey, they all started for the Emerald City; and the Winkies gave them three cheers and many good wishes to carry with them.

You will remember there was no road—not even a pathway—between the castle of the Wicked Witch and the Emerald City. When the four travelers went in search of the Witch she had seen them coming, and so sent the Winged Monkeys to bring them to her. It was much harder to find their way back through the big fields of buttercups and yellow daisies than it was being carried. They knew, of course, they must go straight east, toward the rising sun; and they started off in the right way. But at noon, when the sun was over their heads, they did not know which was east and which was west, and that was the reason they were lost in the great fields. They kept on walking, however, and at night the moon came out and shone brightly. So they lay down among the sweet smelling yellow flowers and slept soundly until morning—all but the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman.
The next morning the sun was behind a cloud, but they started on, as if they were quite sure which way they were going.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what did Dorothy find in the Witch's cupboard?
options: The Golden Cap
A silver key
A map to the Emerald City
A jar of honey

questions.prompt: Per the passage, what did Dorothy do with her sunbonnet after finding the Golden Cap?
options: Carried it in her basket
Left it behind at the castle
Gave it to the Scarecrow
Threw it away

questions.prompt: According to the passage, who gave the travelers three cheers as they set out?
options: The Winkies
The Munchkins
The Winged Monkeys
The soldiers of the Emerald City

questions.prompt: Per the passage, who did the Witch send to bring the travelers to her castle?
options: The Winged Monkeys
The Winkies
Her wolves
Her crows

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what direction did the travelers know they had to go?
options: Straight east, toward the rising sun
Straight north, toward the mountains
Straight south, toward the river
Straight west, back the way they came

questions.prompt: Based on the passage, why did the travelers become lost at noon?
options: They could not tell east from west with the sun directly overhead
They fell asleep and lost track of time
A storm blocked their view of the sun
They deliberately changed direction

questions.prompt: Based on the passage, why was the return journey harder than the trip to the castle?
options: Earlier they had been carried, but now they had to walk and find the way themselves
The fields of flowers had grown much larger overnight
They had lost their map on the way there
The Winged Monkeys refused to help them return

questions.prompt: Based on the passage, what does the last line suggest about the travelers' confidence the next morning?
options: They may not have really known which way they were going
They had finally found the correct road
They had decided to turn back
They no longer needed the sun to navigate

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the overall point of the passage?
options: With no road to follow, the travelers struggled to navigate back to the Emerald City
The Winkies refused to let the travelers leave
Dorothy decided the Golden Cap was too dangerous to wear
The travelers reached the Emerald City by nightfall

questions.prompt: As used in the passage, what does it mean that the Golden Cap "fitted her exactly"?
options: It fit her perfectly
It matched her hair color
It was slightly too big
It had never been worn before

questions.prompt: Per the passage, did Dorothy know about the Golden Cap's charm when she put it on?
options: No, she knew nothing about its charm
Yes, the Witch had explained it to her
Yes, she had read about it in a book
No, but the Winkies warned her about it

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what were the travelers walking through when they got lost?
options: Big fields of buttercups and yellow daisies
A dense, dark forest
A rocky mountain pass
A field of tall corn

questions.prompt: Per the passage, what came out at night to light the travelers' way?
options: The moon
Lanterns carried by the Winkies
Fireflies
A bright star

questions.prompt: According to the passage, where did the travelers lie down to sleep?
options: Among the sweet smelling yellow flowers
Beside a running stream
Under a large oak tree
Inside an abandoned cottage

questions.prompt: Based on the passage, why had the Witch sent the Winged Monkeys earlier in the story?
options: She saw the travelers coming and sent them to bring the travelers to her
She wanted the monkeys to guard the castle
She wanted to test whether the monkeys still obeyed her
She wanted to frighten the Winkies

questions.prompt: Which of these best summarizes what the travelers did despite being lost?
options: They kept walking anyway, resting only when night came
They gave up and returned to the Witch's castle
They sent the Golden Cap ahead to find the way
They waited in place for the Winkies to find them

questions.prompt: As used in the passage, what does it mean that Dorothy "made up her mind" to wear the cap?
options: She decided firmly
She was still uncertain
She was ordered to
She forgot about it soon after
